This instant criminal misc. petition has been filed by the parties for quashing proceeding in criminal case No.30/2019 pending before learned Special Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (PCPNDT Cases), Jodhpur Metropolitan in FIR No.146/2018 and all consequential proceedings for offence under Section 498-A of IPC on the basis of compromise entered between the parties.

entities.text: Special Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate (PCPNDT Cases), Jodhpur Metropolitan
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the parties submit that the petitioner and respondent No.1 are wife and husband.
They have entered into a compromise in the spirit of Lok Adalat and settled their dispute (2 of 2)
[CRLMP-2560/2023] amicably, therefore, the criminal proceedings offence under Section 498-A IPC may be quashed on the basis of compromise.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioner and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in which it has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the criminal proceedings for offence under Section 498-A IPC are liable to be Shaifali vs Yugal Choudhary on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34243620/
1 quashed.
Accordingly, the present misc. petition is disposed of.
